bio.paragraph1: I hold a degree in Internet Systems from the Federal Institute of Maranhão (IFMA) and work as a Backend / Full-Stack Developer and Offensive Security Researcher. I build production systems using Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, Python (FastAPI), PostgreSQL, React Native, and Next.js.
bio.paragraph2: My core competitive advantage lies at the intersection of Software Engineering and Cybersecurity (AppSec/Pentesting): because I deeply understand how REST APIs, relational databases, serverless queues (AWS), and authentication flows (JWT/OAuth2/RLS) are engineered, I can uncover complex business logic flaws that automated scanners miss — and remediate them directly in the codebase.
bio.paragraph3: With professional experience across Simplifit Academias, Developer Community, Timon Municipal Government (ATI), and FAPEMA-funded IoT research, I am ready to contribute to teams building scalable backends or securing critical applications.

items.title: Simplifit Academias — Full-Stack / Mobile Developer
items.description: Architected and built RESTful APIs with Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, and PostgreSQL/MySQL. Led the React Native mobile app, integrated OpenAI LLMs on AWS Serverless (Lambda, SQS, S3), and enforced OWASP security controls (JWT, RBAC, Rate Limiting).

items.title: Developer Community — Full-Stack Developer
items.description: Developed backend services for a SaaS platform (ConstructEasy) using Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. Implemented Supabase Row Level Security (RLS), containerized environments with Docker + Nginx reverse proxy, Linux hardening, and GitHub Actions CI/CD.

items.title: Timon Municipal Government (ATI) — Software Developer Intern
items.description: Contributed to the deployment and REST API integration of the Electronic Information System (SEI) and institutional portals using Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Docker, applying CSP headers, HTTPS, and server hardening.

items.title: FAPEMA / IFMA — Research Fellow (IoT & Backend) & Security Researcher
items.description: Engineered a real-time environmental monitoring system using ESP32 microcontrollers, MQTT, NestJS + Prisma backend, and Next.js dashboard, alongside continuous Offensive Security & Bug Bounty research on HackerOne.
